name: horizontal
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity UI design mockup of the CBTipul native iPhone patient detail screen, portrait 1170x2532. This is an actual usable mobile interface concept, not a poster, no device bezel, no external captions. The reference screenshot supplies native iOS chrome, Hebrew typography, icons and existing product content; deliberately change its layout according to this concept. Hebrew RTL. Large readable system typography, realistic 44pt touch targets. Keep navy #0C1420, surface #172231, white #F3F5F8, secondary #B4C0D0, gold primary action #E2BB76. Add appreciably MORE COLOR through the existing patient identity color teal #00C2A8: identity avatar, tinted region surfaces and journey nodes. Teal is one patient's identity, NOT clinical improvement. Elegant precise native product UI, compact and informative, clearly separated sections. Fictional patient name 'ישראלה ישראלית', prominent, with initials avatar and active status 'פעיל/ה'. Treatment goal must be near the TOP, compact 2-line text only, small label 'מטרת הטיפול', pencil and 'הרחבה' secondary action. Exact goal text 'הורדת רמת התסכול מ־90% ל־50% בסיטואציות של חרדה חברתית'. Do not enlarge into a giant goal card. Full recorded journey contains FOUR stages newest to oldest: 'יומן מחשבות 2' '2 מפגשים'; 'יומן מחשבות 1' '2 מפגשים'; 'פסיכו־חינוכי' 'מפגש אחד'; 'אינטייק' '2 מפגשים'. No score or improvement curve. Preserve compact connection strip 'מחובר/ת לאפליקציה' with 'שליחת משימה'. Activity heading 'מאז הפגישה האחרונה' with count 3; rows 'יומן מחשבות 2' and 'שאלון מצב רוח' with small dates, link 'הצגת הכל'. Gold primary button 'מפגש חדש' plus secondary 'הכנה לפגישה'. Record actions under 'התיק הטיפולי': RTL 2-column grid right 'פגישות', left 'גרפים ומגמות'; right 'יומני מחשבות', left 'שאלונים'. Fifth full-width action 'שיחת AI'. Notes and messages as small final row 'הערות' 'הודעות'. Native bottom 5-tab navigation, right-to-left 'מטופלים' selected, 'פגישות', 'AI', 'התראות', 'הגדרות'. Small SF Symbols style line icons, no emoji. Fit this as a realistic dense but readable iPhone screen with no giant empty gaps. Crisp legible Hebrew.
CONCEPT A: HORIZONTAL JOURNEY RIBBON. Full-width layout. Teal avatar beside prominent name on navy. Compact goal directly under name, no tall wrapper. Below it a tinted teal full-width horizontal band labeled 'רצף הטיפול', FOUR equal visual nodes connected by a slim line, newest stage at RIGHT, oldest at LEFT. Each has short wrapped stage name and count, all FOUR visible simultaneously. Journey uses roughly 100pt height. Main activity digest below has full phone width, then session actions and record grid. Teal appears confidently in avatar, entire journey band's subtle tint, selected tab and some action icon badges; gold remains primary session CTA. Most balanced and readable variation.
